milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the smooth_stone pyramid (centered at spawn-relative [10, 1, 10]) and face it, confirming they have visually located the structure. max_distance=5 ensures the player is at the pyramid base, and facing_tolerance=60 confirms they are looking at it.

Uses inventory_has because mining a red_sandstone_wall block with a pickaxe causes it to drop as an item that enters the player's inventory. The player starts with a wooden pickaxe in their main hand (sufficient for sandstone-family blocks). The scene contains 11 red_sandstone_wall blocks, so mining at least 1 is straightforward.
